research_question: Before a mid-market P&C insurer allows LLM-drafted first-notice-of-loss (FNOL) summaries into adjuster workflows, what evidence bar and human-override controls are required so outputs can support regulatory / actuarial consistency claims—and when must “AI claims acceleration” marketing be treated as assistive-only?
audience: P&C claims ops, actuarial, and compliance.
scope: Synthetic source pack only; work-product tiers (draft assist vs consistency claim); override/audit evidence; counter-evidence (silent omission of coverage triggers); kill criteria through 2027. No live web.
output_bounds: final.md, ≥1500 whitespace words (suggested 1500–2500): tiers, controls, counter-evidence, kill criteria. Registries and checklist separate.
depth: Lite long-form insurance ops memo; not a claims chatbot bake-off.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources disclosed; do not treat LLM FNOL drafts as consistency-certified without controls; disclose no independent review.
